title: The RSA cryptographic key material, including a private key and public key, is embedded within the… (CVE-2026-124604)
description: The GV-Cloud Android application package contains embedded RSA cryptographic key material, including both private and public keys. Because Android apps can be extracted and reverse engineered, storing private keys directly inside the client application risks key recovery by attackers. This could enable impersonation of the application or unauthorized cryptographic operations. The vulnerability has a medium severity with a CVSS score of 6.2.
